description: NaSe₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅42d space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.12 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.17 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Se atoms. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.38 Å) Se-Se bond length. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Se atom.
